title: The Creative Surveillance
setup: Five days after Ultimate Boon completion, Francisco returning to action with complexity capacity but needing new visions for transformed rebellion. A creativity coach appears teaching Kelley's Creative Confidence—building creative muscle through iteration, prototyping bold ideas without fear. Francisco implements: vision sketching, rapid prototyping, fearless ideation. Liberating—ideas flowing after framework-heavy chapters. But coach is Record Keeper innovation-tracker harvesting every creative vision. Francisco's boldest dreams catalogued, analyzed, pre-empted. Before rebellion can implement vision, enemies already built counter-version or positioned obstacles. Creative confidence becomes creative surveillance—every idea stolen before manifestation.
symbolism: Page of Cups offering cup of visions but cup transparent—enemies seeing dreams before dreamer acts. When Francisco learns internal visioning (imagining without externalizing), Page holds opaque cup.
beat_goal: Francisco must recognize externalized creativity enables idea-theft—true visioning happens internally, shared only when ready for action not during ideation.
core_emotion: Creative liberation exploited hardening to protected internal visioning
scene_tone: Fearless ideation violated yielding to guarded imagination

title: The Morning Pages Extraction
setup: Six weeks into protected imagination, new challenge: internal visioning isolated—Francisco dreaming alone, no creative community. An artist appears teaching Cameron's Morning Pages—daily stream-of-consciousness writing clearing creative blocks, accessing subconscious visions. Francisco implements: private morning pages, unfiltered expression, creative flow. Transformative—accessing deeper visions than protected imagination alone achieved. But artist is Record Keeper subconscious-mapper. Through subtle prompts in 'innocent' conversations, she triggers Francisco writing specific topics in morning pages, creating psychological profile. Pages themselves stay private but writing patterns revealed through behavioral observation. Morning pages extraction: not reading pages but reading writer.
symbolism: Page of Cups drinking own visions (morning pages) but cup poisoning drinker—self-reflection weaponized. When Francisco recognizes behavioral leakage, shifts to mental morning pages (thinking not writing), Page purifies.
beat_goal: Francisco must recognize even private creative practices create observable patterns—true safety requires mental not written expression eliminating behavioral surveillance.
core_emotion: Creative flow violated by behavioral tracking shifting to mental practice

title: The Transparency Trap
setup: Seven weeks into mental creative practice, final challenge: thoughtful silence protected but isolated—no creative accountability, vision quality unchecked. A facilitator appears teaching Kleon's Show Your Work—sharing creative process builds community, transparency enables feedback improving vision quality. Francisco torn: transparency would improve visions (community input) but return to surveillance vulnerability. Implements carefully: shares completed work not process, reveals outcomes not ideation. But facilitator demonstrates ultimate trap: even showing finished work reveals thinking patterns. Francisco's completed visions expose problem-solving approach, value priorities, strategic inclinations. Show Your Work weaponized as completed-thought-extraction. No amount of careful sharing protects when work itself reveals mind.
symbolism: Page of Cups offering filled cup to community—generous but exposing. When Francisco accepts creativity sans community (solo visioning accepting isolation as protection price), Page drinks alone but pure.

title: The Vision That Matters
setup: Nine weeks into solitary visioning, Francisco discovers final creative truth: despite perfect protection creating quality concerns and isolation pain, the visions emerging in solitude are purest. No community input means no consensus-dilution. No feedback means values undistorted by others' preferences. No sharing means dreams untainted by reception anxiety. The protected creative practice—internal, mental, solitary—produces visions that are genuinely Francisco's not committee-refined compromises. Page of Cups offering most authentic drink: lonely but true. Creative Idealism complete recognizing adversarial conditions transform creativity from community co-creation into fiercely guarded solo act, and that solitary purity—despite all costs—produces most authentic visions worth the isolation price.
